scope: Processor cost of the CARMA sample paths: the TFG-CARMA cores use structured, plain-array covariance kernels, and the QMEKF CARMA cores index plain storage with unchanged arithmetic. The estimator models, noises, gains, thresholds and public interfaces are unchanged. Instruction counts and numerical comparisons only: no ESP32 board was connected and no Xtensa code was executed.

instruction_proxy.meaning: x86-64 instructions per 200 Hz core step, including 0.1 s model commits and 25 Hz magnetic updates, with the firmware's optimization flags and Eigen assertions enabled as in the Arduino build. Deterministic; not Xtensa cycles and not a deadline measurement.
instruction_proxy.counter: valgrind-3.22.0 callgrind, inclusive cost of each run<Core>() over --seconds 10
instruction_proxy.current_revision_note: current: main after the measured-endpoint gyro integration (#746) with the QMEKF storage-access change; baseline: baseline_revision

binary64_core.meaning: Maximum absolute difference between baseline and current cores over 300 s at 200 Hz (60,000 steps, 0.1 s commits, 100 Hz magnetic updates, 2% interval jitter), every 20th step printed with nine significant digits.

binary32_wrapper.meaning: Maximum / RMS absolute difference of the tests/kalman_carma_shared_modes/refactor_trace.cpp wrapper trace (600 s, 6,000 printed rows). The control changes only compiler rounding of the baseline (-O2 -mfma -ffp-contract=fast against -O1).
bit_identical_to_baseline: TFG (SeaStateFusionFilter_TFG on the same stream; also with -O2 -mfma -ffp-contract=fast)

qmekf_cores.meaning: The QMEKF CARMA cores changed storage access only. Wrapper traces of tests/kalman_carma_shared_modes/refactor_trace.cpp (600 s, 6,000 printed rows) against the tree before that change.

not_repeated: esp32s3_size_stack.csv and firmware_builds.json (Xtensa object sizes, stack-chain bounds and linked firmware sizes) predate the restructured kernels
the on-device 200 Hz probe: no board
the registered study scores (runs.csv.gz and derived tables): produced by the registered executable; the restructured kernels change binary32 rounding only

host_timing.meaning: Median over four counterbalanced repetitions of the mean and 99th-percentile time of one 200 Hz core step at the test suite's flags (-O3 -funroll-loops -march=native), same container and pinned CPU for both trees, measured in alternation. Ranking only; not an ESP32 time.

qmekf_storage_access.meaning: Median mean time per step in a later session on the tree before #746, the tree before and after the QMEKF storage-access change measured in alternation on one pinned CPU. At -O3 the accessors are already inline, so host time does not change beyond run-to-run variation; host_timing.csv, host_jitter.csv and host_fixed.csv are not re-measured. Absolute times differ between sessions.

deterministic_replay.meaning: Largest change of a gated metric over the eight pinned vessel records against measured_worst in deterministic_regression.json (which was produced by a different compiler); all eight quality gates pass with the committed limits.
